title: Stripe story carousel
description: Segment opener over a sideways-scrolling row of tall picture cards with white wordmarks, a light caption and an indigo story link; small square arrow buttons on desktop. Two pale promo cards close it, each with a bold violet or sun-yellow corner shape.
notes: the arrows use a ref to scroll: needs hydration; without it the row still scrolls by touch and trackpad
the row bleeds off the right edge of the page column, as on the original
